conditions: Real angles a and b in consistent units.
spoken_aliases: sine of open parenthesis a plus b close parenthesis equals sine of a times cosine of b plus cosine of a times sine of b
sine of the sum of a and b equals the product of sine of a and cosine of b plus the product of cosine of a and sine of b

evidence: Compose the planar rotation matrices for angles a and b. Their bottom-left product entry is sin(a)cos(b)+cos(a)sin(b), which equals the bottom-left entry sin(a+b) of the combined rotation.

Reference cross-check of the standard relationship: https://openstax.org/books/precalculus-2e/pages/7-2-sum-and-difference-identities. Checked 2026-11-27. Proposed maintainer approval; not independent human certification.
